name: Vaulted Deep
subsector: bio-waste carbon dioxide removal via deep well injection
one_liner: Injects dewatered organic waste deep underground for durable carbon removal, backed by Frontier Climate offtake agreements.

signals.notes: This $35M is a debt facility, not a priced equity round (stage left null). Company has also raised $48M in equity funding to date per same source; backed by long-term carbon removal and waste-servicing agreements via Frontier Climate.
